answer: Each agent pins content carrying the garden, karst and ferrous markers to IPFS within 10 minutes and publishes the CID and multiaddress. Peers fetch it through 3 independent public gateways, verify the CID, and confirm the challenge hash. One honest agent runs 1 IPFS node pinning 1 CID for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must run 10 nodes pinning 10 CIDs, so hosting and pinning costs rise 10X. A missing pin, CID mismatch, gateway fetch failure, or late timestamp slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
